paragraphs.en: A modern platform for visual, flexible, and extensible graph-based investigations. For cybersecurity analysts and investigators.
paragraphs.zh: 一个用于可视化、灵活且可扩展的基于图的调查的现代平台。 面向网络安全分析师和调查人员。

sents.en: A modern platform for visual, flexible, and extensible graph-based investigations.
sents.zh: 一个用于可视化、灵活且可扩展的基于图的调查的现代平台。

sents.en: For cybersecurity analysts and investigators.

paragraphs.en: Flowsint is an open-source OSINT graph exploration tool designed for ethical investigation, transparency, and verification.
paragraphs.zh: Flowsint 是一款开源的 OSINT 图谱探索工具，专为合乎道德的调查、透明度与验证而设计。

paragraphs.en: Ethics: Please read ETHICS.md for responsible use guidelines.
paragraphs.zh: 伦理：请阅读 ETHICS.md 以了解负责任使用指南。

paragraphs.en: Flowsint is still in early development and definetly needs the help of the community! Feel free to raise issues, propose features, etc.
paragraphs.zh: Flowsint 仍处于早期开发阶段，非常需要社区的帮助！ 欢迎随时提出问题（issue）、建议新功能等。

paragraphs.en: The same setup works out of the box on a server: the frontend serves the UI and proxies all API calls internally, so no extra configuration is needed for clients.
paragraphs.zh: 同样的设置在服务器上开箱即用：前端提供 UI 并在内部代理所有 API 调用，因此客户端无需额外配置。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/reconurge/flowsint.git cd flowsint cp .env.example .env # Edit .env — see "Before exposing to a network" below docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d Anyone on the network can then access Flowsint at http://<server-ip>:5173 .
paragraphs.zh:
```
git clone https://github.com/reconurge/flowsint.git
cd flowsint
cp .env.example .env
# 编辑 .env — 参见下文「在暴露到网络之前」
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

随后，网络上的任何人都可以通过 http://<server-ip>:5173 访问 Flowsint。

paragraphs.en: Before exposing to a network, change the default secrets in .env :
paragraphs.zh: 在暴露到网络之前，请更改 .env 中的默认密钥：

paragraphs.en: Also add your server hostname/IP to the Host-header allowlist in flowsint-app/nginx.conf (look for map $http_host $is_flowsint_host ). The default allowlist accepts only localhost / 127.0.0.1 / [::1] , which defends single-user installs against DNS rebinding; LAN and public deploys must opt-in their own hostname. Two commented-out template lines in the same map block show the format.
paragraphs.zh: 同时，请在 flowsint-app/nginx.conf 的 Host 头白名单中添加你的服务器主机名/IP（查找 map $http_host $is_flowsint_host ）。 默认白名单仅接受 localhost / 127.0.0.1 / [::1]，这可以为单用户安装防御 DNS 重绑定攻击；局域网和公网部署必须自行将其主机名加入白名单。 同一 map 块中有两行被注释掉的模板，展示了相应的格式。

sents.en: Also add your server hostname/IP to the Host-header allowlist in flowsint-app/nginx.conf (look for map $http_host $is_flowsint_host ).
sents.zh: 同时，请在 flowsint-app/nginx.conf 的 Host 头白名单中添加你的服务器主机名/IP（查找 map $http_host $is_flowsint_host ）。

sents.en: The default allowlist accepts only localhost / 127.0.0.1 / [::1] , which defends single-user installs against DNS rebinding; LAN and public deploys must opt-in their own hostname.
sents.zh: 默认白名单仅接受 localhost / 127.0.0.1 / [::1]，这可以为单用户安装防御 DNS 重绑定攻击；局域网和公网部署必须自行将其主机名加入白名单。

sents.en: Two commented-out template lines in the same map block show the format.
sents.zh: 同一 map 块中有两行被注释掉的模板，展示了相应的格式。

paragraphs.en: Only port 5173 is exposed to the network. PostgreSQL, Redis, Neo4j and the API are bound to 127.0.0.1 on the server and reachable only through the frontend proxy.
paragraphs.zh: 仅端口 5173 对外暴露到网络。 PostgreSQL、Redis、Neo4j 和 API 在服务器上绑定到 127.0.0.1，只能通过前端代理访问。

paragraphs.en: HTTPS (recommended beyond a trusted LAN): put any reverse proxy in front of port 5173. Example with Caddy :
paragraphs.zh: HTTPS（建议在受信任的局域网之外使用）：在端口 5173 前面放置任意反向代理即可。以 Caddy 为例：

paragraphs.en: flowsint.example.com { reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:5173 } When fronting with a reverse proxy, also bind the app port to localhost in docker-compose.prod.yml ( "127.0.0.1:5173:8080" ) so clients can only go through HTTPS.
paragraphs.zh: flowsint.example.com { reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:5173 } 当使用反向代理进行前置时，还需在 docker-compose.prod.yml 中将应用端口绑定到 localhost（ "127.0.0.1:5173:8080" ），这样客户端只能通过 HTTPS 访问。

paragraphs.en: Flowsint is a graph-based investigation tool focused on reconnaissance and OSINT (Open Source Intelligence). It allows you to explore relationships between entities through a visual graph interface and automated enrichers.
paragraphs.zh: Flowsint 是一款基于图的调查工具，专注于侦察和开源情报（OSINT）。 它让你可以通过可视化图界面和自动化富化器来探索实体之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: The project is organized into autonomous modules:
paragraphs.zh: 该项目由自主模块组成：

paragraphs.en: flowsint-app (frontend) ↓ flowsint-api (API server) ↓ flowsint-core (orchestrator, tasks, vault) ↓ flowsint-enrichers (enrichers & tools) ↓ flowsint-types (types) Development setup Prerequisites Docker Run Linux / macOS (requires Make ):
paragraphs.zh: flowsint-app（前端） ↓ flowsint-api（API 服务器） ↓ flowsint-core（编排器、任务、保险库） ↓ flowsint-enrichers（增强器与工具） ↓ flowsint-types（类型） 开发环境搭建 前提条件 Docker 运行 Linux / macOS（需要 Make ）：

paragraphs.en: make dev Windows (cmd or PowerShell, no Make — create the .env files first, see Get started ):
paragraphs.zh: make dev Windows（cmd 或 PowerShell，无 Make —— 需先创建 .env 文件，参见 Get started ）：

paragraphs.en: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f Development The app is accessible at http://localhost:5173 .
paragraphs.zh: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f 开发 应用可通过 http://localhost:5173 访问。

paragraphs.en: # Test core module cd flowsint-core uv run pytest # Test types module cd ../flowsint-types uv run pytest # Test enrichers module cd ../flowsint-enrichers uv run pytest # Test API module cd ../flowsint-api uv run pytest Contributing Follow the modular structure Use uv for dependency management Write tests for new functionality Update documentation as needed See CONTRIBUTING.md for the checks to run before committing ⚖️ Legal & Ethical Use Ethics: Please read ETHICS.md for responsible use guidelines.
paragraphs.zh: # 测试 core 模块 cd flowsint-core uv run pytest # 测试 types 模块 cd ../flowsint-types uv run pytest # 测试 enrichers 模块 cd ../flowsint-enrichers uv run pytest # 测试 API 模块 cd ../flowsint-api uv run pytest 贡献 遵循模块化结构 使用 uv 进行依赖管理 为新功能编写测试 根据需要更新文档 提交前需要运行的检查请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md ⚖️ 法律与伦理使用 伦理：请阅读 ETHICS.md 了解负责任使用的准则。

paragraphs.en: Flowsint is designed strictly for lawful, ethical investigation and research purposes .
paragraphs.zh: Flowsint 严格设计用于合法、符合道德的调查与研究目的。

paragraphs.en: Any misuse of this software is strictly prohibited and goes against the ethical principles defined in ETHICS.md .
paragraphs.zh: 严禁任何滥用本软件的行为，此类行为违反了 ETHICS.md 中定义的伦理原则。
